scheme_name: Shahidvir Kinariwaala Student Security Group Insurance Scheme
description:
The Shahidvir Kinariwaala Student Security Group Insurance Scheme was launched by the Government of Madhya Pradesh on 1st November 2021. 

This scheme is named after Shahid Vir Kinariwala, a soldier who sacrificed his life for the nation. 

The primary objective of this scheme is to provide financial security to students in the event of unforeseen circumstances. 

The scheme aims to cover students from economically weaker sections of society. 

It specifically targets students enrolled in government schools and colleges across Madhya Pradesh. 

The scheme provides a group insurance cover of ₹2 lakh for each student. 

This insurance cover is applicable in cases of accidental death or permanent disability. 

The scheme is designed to alleviate the financial burden on families in case of tragic events. 

The government has set a target to enroll approximately 10 lakh students under this scheme within the first year of its launch. 

The eligibility criteria for this scheme include students who are enrolled in classes 9 to 12 in government schools. 

Students pursuing undergraduate and postgraduate courses in government colleges are also eligible. 

There is no specific age limit mentioned for eligibility under this scheme. 

However, students must belong to families with an annual income of less than ₹2 lakh. 

This income criterion ensures that the benefits reach those who are most in need. 

The application process for the Shahidvir Kinariwaala Student Security Group Insurance Scheme is straightforward. 

Students must fill out an application form which is available at their respective schools or colleges. 

The application form requires basic information such as the student's name, age, class, and family income. 

Students must submit a copy of their income certificate along with the application form. 

Additionally, a copy of the student’s identity proof is also required. 

Once the application is submitted, it is verified by the school or college authorities. 

After verification, the application is forwarded to the district education office for final approval. 

The insurance cover becomes effective once the application is approved. 

The scheme has a provision for annual renewal to ensure continued coverage. 

The disbursement of benefits under this scheme occurs in the event of an accident leading to death or disability. 

In such cases, the family of the deceased or disabled student can claim the insurance amount. 

The claim process requires the submission of necessary documents such as a death certificate or disability certificate. 

The claim must be submitted to the insurance company designated by the government. 

The government has partnered with various insurance providers to facilitate this scheme. 

The implementing authority for this scheme is the Department of School Education, Madhya Pradesh. 

The district education officers are responsible for overseeing the implementation at the local level. 

The scheme is part of the broader initiative by the Madhya Pradesh government to enhance student welfare. 

It reflects the government's commitment to ensuring the safety and security of students. 

The scheme is expected to significantly reduce the financial strain on families in distressing situations. 

As of October 2023, the scheme has successfully enrolled over 5 lakh students within the first two years. 

The Madhya Pradesh government has allocated a budget of ₹100 crore for this scheme for the financial year 2023-2024. 

This allocation demonstrates the government's dedication to student welfare and security. 

The scheme also aims to raise awareness about the importance of insurance among students and their families. 

Workshops and seminars are being conducted in schools to educate families about the benefits of the scheme. 

The government plans to expand the coverage to include students from private institutions in the future. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is being collected to improve the scheme further. 

The scheme has received positive responses from parents and educational institutions alike. 

The government is also exploring the possibility of increasing the insurance cover amount in subsequent years. 

The initiative aligns with the national goal of ensuring the safety and security of students across the country. 

The Madhya Pradesh government is committed to making education accessible and safe for all students. 

The Shahidvir Kinariwaala Student Security Group Insurance Scheme is a step towards achieving that goal. 

It is a unique initiative that combines education with financial security. 

The scheme is expected to inspire similar initiatives in other states across India. 

The government encourages all eligible students to take advantage of this scheme. 

The scheme not only provides financial assistance but also peace of mind to families. 

In conclusion, the Shahidvir Kinariwaala Student Security Group Insurance Scheme is a significant welfare initiative. 

It aims to protect students from financial hardships due to unforeseen accidents. 

The scheme is a testament to the Madhya Pradesh government's commitment to student welfare. 

It serves as a model for other states to follow in ensuring the safety and security of students. 

The ongoing efforts to improve and expand the scheme reflect the government's proactive approach. 

The scheme is a crucial step in safeguarding the future of students in Madhya Pradesh.
